title: Seating
description: Arrange with presets or shuffle, then fine-tune by dragging.

canvas.label: Seating canvas. Arrow keys move between seats, Enter picks/places, L locks

shuffle.seedHelp: Enter the same seed to reproduce the same arrangement.
shuffle.reproNote: If the run hits its time limit, results may vary slightly with computer speed.

presets.nothingToSave: These presets can't be saved as rules
presets.needsPrevious: Last year's seats haven't been entered yet
presets.overwriteBody: Create a new plan to keep the current one as it is.

mixLab.name: Mix labs
mixLab.description: Match each room's lab mix to the overall ratio and seat different labs side by side (for shared labs).

seniorBack.name: Seniors at the back
seniorBack.description: Seats more senior members farther from the entrance.

seniorFront.name: Seniors by the door
seniorFront.description: Seats more senior members closer to the entrance.

clusterLab.name: Group by lab
clusterLab.description: Keeps each lab together in the same room and side by side.

clusterRole.name: Group by year
clusterRole.description: Seats people of the same role/year next to each other.

mixRole.name: Mix years
mixRole.description: Neighbours have different roles/years where possible.

keepPrevious.name: Keep last year
keepPrevious.description: Keeps people in last year's seats where possible.

movePrevious.name: Everyone moves
movePrevious.description: Moves people to a different room from last year where possible.

nameOrder.name: Name order
nameOrder.description: Seats people in name order along seat labels.

random.name: Fully random
random.description: Random arrangement that only keeps required rules.

rows.moved: Moved to another room vs last year

year.banner: You are editing last year's seats. Drag to recreate last year's layout (synced with the Members list).

mobile.viewOnly: View-only on phones. Please edit on a computer.

empty.title: Let's get ready to seat people
empty.body: You need both rooms (with seats) and members to arrange seating.

diag.title: No arrangement satisfies all rules
diag.body: The required rules may be impossible to satisfy for these reasons.
diag.emptyDomain: There is no seat {{member}} can take (rule {{rule}} and others).
diag.seatConflict: Several people are pinned to the same seat {{seat}} ({{names}}).
diag.restrictedSeatsShortage: Not enough restricted seats ({{people}} people, {{seats}} seats).
diag.danglingMember: Rule {{rule}} refers to a deleted member.
diag.danglingSeat: Rule {{rule}} refers to a deleted seat.
diag.danglingRoom: Rule {{rule}} refers to a deleted room.
diag.danglingLab: Rule {{rule}} refers to a deleted lab.
diag.noPreviousPlan: Rule {{rule}} needs last year's seats, which are not entered.
diag.danglingLock: There is a lock on a deleted seat.
